thread:
zoe: Quick digest from today's sync: we need a clear, low-friction launch lane for private deployments that preserves customer egress IPs and makes upgrades non-disruptive.
diego: Proposal: three lanes — "Minimal Operator" (daemonset, preserves host egress), "Relay Assist" (for NATed egress), "Airgap Bundle" (offline installer + KMS samples).
rana: Customers care about predictable rollback and cert rotation. Suggest we include a 'fast rollback' flag and automated cert-refresh job in the operator.
eli: Acceptance criteria draft: upgrade pass rate >=98% in test harness; rollback <=10m for 90% cases; documented KMS/HSM onboarding; preflight script for connectivity & CA checks.
zoe: Test matrix to validate: single-node airgapped, VPC with NAT, VPC with egress IP retention, hybrid peered DC. Keep canaries small (1-3 customers) initially.
diego: Minimal Operator scope for sprint: egress-preserve controller v0, preflight script, basic runbook. Relay Assist is next sprint; airgap bundle parallel doc work.
rana: Risk notes: Relay adds latency; HSM vendors differ (we'll provide adapter pattern); airgap fails often due to CA bundles—add explicit CA import step.
eli: Preflight example (very small):
```
# preflight
curl -sf https://status.internal/ok || echo "connectivity-fail"
# check permission to bind low ports and available disk
```
zoe: Owners: diego (operator), rana (KMS/runbook), eli (preflight & tests). Ops-bot reserved maintenance slot: 2024-09-10 02:00-05:00 UTC.
diego: Ack, will open operator PR and demo in next weekly.
rana: I'll draft KMS adapter spec and include a vendor matrix.
eli: I'll build preflight and the canary checklist.
zoe: Final ask: product signoff on lanes and acceptance criteria by EOD Friday. If we get that, we'll schedule the spike next week.
